Metadata.description: Neoqlick builds and runs Cruising, Swipe and Videochat: apps for adults (18+), with one Neoqlick account for all of them.

Login.metaDescription: Sign in to your Neoqlick account to use Cruising, Swipe and Videochat.
Login.subtitle: Use your Neoqlick account in Cruising, Swipe and Videochat.

Register.metaDescription: Create your Neoqlick account, for adults (18+), and use Cruising, Swipe and Videochat with one sign-in.
Register.subtitle: One account for Cruising, Swipe and Videochat. You must be 18 or older.

Account.deleteHasProjects: Your account has projects with us, with their contracts and invoices, so we close it for you: open a support request or write to hello@neoqlick.com and we will.
Account.yourDataBody: Download as a file (JSON) everything we keep about you: your account, sessions and your data in Cruising, Swipe and Videochat.
Account.deleteBody: Your account and what hangs from it (your profiles, messages and photos in Cruising, Swipe and Videochat…) will be deleted. This cannot be undone. You will get a confirmation email.

overview.lead: One Neoqlick account for every app. Sign in here once and every app knows you.
overview.apps: {count, plural, =0 {You don't use any app yet.} one {You use # Neoqlick app.} other {You use # Neoqlick apps.}}

profile.lead: How you appear across Neoqlick: in the apps only your username shows.

Passkeys.lead: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of your password and code. A passkey lives on your device or in your password manager and only works on Neoqlick.

Error.body: Please try again. If the problem persists, write to hello@neoqlick.com.
